mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals a weakening in the housing market and broader economic demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side dynamics, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strengthening consumer demand and labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and GDP growth (GDPC1) is below 2% YoY, it signals a tightening monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increases over two consecutive quarters.
